title: Hearty Brazilian Roast Swede
description: A flavorful and comforting Brazilian-inspired dish featuring roasted swede and beef.
instructions: Toss the chopped swede with olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast the swede in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and caramelized.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced beef and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until browned and cooked to your liking.
Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside.
Add the minced roasted garlic to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
Add the beef broth to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the beef to the skillet and simmer for 5-7 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
Serve the beef with the roasted swede and garnish with chopped cilantro.
Season with salt, pepper, and Brazilian spice blend to taste.
